title: Recurring price increase rounds the percentage to two decimals of a fraction

bugs.note: The rate is percentage / 100 and that fraction is rounded to two places, which is whole percent: a 2.5 percent increase becomes 3 percent, 0.4 becomes 0, 1.5 becomes 2. Every line of every selected recurring invoice is repriced with the wrong factor, and all later invoices generated from it bill the wrong amount.
